meta.title: Naeba Ski Resort
meta.description: ~40–45 min by bus from Echigo-Yuzawa Station — 134 ha Mt.Naeba with 4,000 m runs. Naeba Prince Hotel ski-in, Dragon Gondola to Kagura, après at Yukisasa baths and local dining.

transit.title:
From Echigo-Yuzawa,
~40–45 min by bus.
transit.lead: ~40–45 minutes by local or shuttle bus from Joetsu Shinkansen Echigo-Yuzawa Station to Naeba Prince Hotel — stay ski-in/ski-out at 0 min from your room, or day-trip the groomed wide runs and Dragon Gondola link to Kagura.
transit.imgAlt: Winter bus on snowy mountain road — journey from Echigo-Yuzawa Station to Naeba

primary.title: Mt.Naeba scale
primary.lead: 134 ha and 4,000 m longest run — Japan's 5,481 m Dragon Gondola links Naeba to Kagura for one of the country's largest ski networks. From gentle hotel-front beginner terrain to 39° Splash Bowl, more than a single day can cover.
primary.imgAlt: Dragon Gondola crossing snowy ridges — panoramic Mt.Naeba terrain

secondary.title: After skiing, baths & local food
secondary.lead: Step outside the hotel bubble to Yukisasa-no-Yu brown-spring baths and neighborhood spots like Wakakiya and Ikoi — après loops that extend beyond resort-only stays.

onsen.title:
Yukisasa baths &
Naeba onsen loop
onsen.lead: From in-resort spas to day-use springs with a hidden-hot-spring feel — recovery and evening walks on one line.
onsen.whisper: Confirm day-use rules and hours on each facility's official site. Watch winter road conditions.
onsen.imgAlt: Snow-framed outdoor bath — Yukisasa-no-Yu at Naeba

yukisasa.title: Naeba Onsen Yukisasa-no-Yu
yukisasa.lead: 355 Mikuni, Yuzawa. Brown flowing spring with a hidden-bath feel outside the hotel. TEL 025-780-9500. https://yukisasa.net/

shukuba.title: Ni-kai Shukuba-no-Yu
shukuba.lead: 537 Mikuni, Yuzawa. Local communal bath evoking the Mikuni Kaido post town — a reason to stay beyond slopes-only. Confirm hours officially.
shukuba.imgAlt: Shukuba-no-Yu communal bath at Mikuni Pass

kaikake.title: Kaikake Onsen
kaikake.lead: 686 Mitsumata, Yuzawa. A short drive from Naeba for a different après soak. Confirm hours officially.
kaikake.imgAlt: Kaikake Onsen — Yuzawa hidden hot spring

nearbyOnsen.pairingLead: Morning family lessons at hotel-front runs → afternoon Dragon Gondola to Kagura → Yukisasa-no-Yu → Wakakiya or Ikoi for dinner → Shukuba-no-Yu to finish.

wakakiya.title: Wakakiya Shokudo
wakakiya.lead: 69-1 Mikuni, Yuzawa. Beloved ramen and set meals — a go-to when you want dinner outside the hotel. TEL 025-789-2041. https://naeba.jp/restaurant/wakakiya/
wakakiya.imgAlt: Wakakiya Shokudo — neighborhood canteen at Naeba

ikoi.title: Ikoi Shokudo
ikoi.lead: 211-2 Mikuni, Yuzawa. Late-night izakaya and ramen for après hunger. TEL 025-783-3217. https://naeba.jp/restaurant/ikoi/
ikoi.imgAlt: Ikoi Shokudo — local izakaya at Naeba

nearbyFood.pairingLead: Morning kids' lessons → Dragon Gondola to Kagura → Yukisasa-no-Yu → Wakakiya or Ikoi dinner → Shukuba-no-Yu finish.

dragon.title: Dragon Gondola 5,481 m
dragon.body: Japan's longest-class gondola links Naeba and Kagura — Mt.Naeba shared tickets unlock backcountry-scale distance in one day. May close in high winds (check official status).

prince-hotel.title: 0 min from Naeba Prince Hotel
prince-hotel.body: Naeba Prince Hotel towers at the base — rental, school, and dining under one roof, with free lift passes for elementary kids and under via the Kids Free Program.

night-hop.title: Naeba night hopping
night-hop.body: Leave the hotel bubble for Yukisasa-no-Yu, Wakakiya, Ikoi, and yakiniku Tokichi — a local bath-and-bar loop similar to Nozawa's hashigo culture, designed inside the Naeba area.
